notices.title: Annual Alumni Meet 2026 — Darbhanga Hall
notices.body: All registered alumni are invited to the Annual Alumni Meet on 20 December 2026, 4:00 PM onwards. Please confirm attendance through the portal by 10 December.

notices.title: Applications open for the 2027 Convocation
notices.body: Graduates of the 2024–25 sessions may apply to receive their degree in person. Last date for online application: 15 December 2026.

notices.title: Online application for original degree certificates and transcripts
notices.body: Alumni requiring original degree certificates, migration certificates or official transcripts can now apply online. Processing time is about 21 working days.

notices.title: Call for alumni mentors — final-year students
notices.body: The placement cell invites alumni to mentor final-year students for one hour a month. Mentors from industry, research and civil services are especially welcome.

notices.title: Revised office hours of the Alumni Cell
notices.body: From 1 November 2026, the Alumni Cell at the College Street campus will be open Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM to 4:30 PM.

messages.body: Good evening everyone! Anyone from the 2012 batch planning to come for the alumni meet?
I'll be there. It's been years since I walked through College Street on a weekday 🙂
Count me in too. Should we organise a small coffee house meetup the same evening?
My team is hiring two data analysts in Bengaluru. Happy to refer CU alumni — DM me.

feedback.title: Add electives in AI safety and cloud computing
feedback.body: The current M.Tech syllabus has no elective on cloud platforms or responsible AI. Alumni working in these areas could co-design and guest-teach the modules.
feedback.reply: Placed before the Board of Studies for the next syllabus revision.

feedback.title: Shared instrument booking across science campuses
feedback.body: Expensive instruments at Rajabazar and Ballygunge are under-used because booking is manual. An online booking calendar shared by all departments would increase use.
